pages.text:
Security Services Platform 5.0
Deploying the Security Services Platform
Setting up a Security Services Platform environment requires deploying the SSP Installer and an SSP instance. Here is
the high-level workflow to set up an SSP environment.
1.Deploy the installer virtual appliance.
2.Upload the SSP file to the SSP Installer.
3.Deploy an SSP instance.
4.From the SSP instance's UI, onboard an NSX Manager.
5.From the SSP instance's UI, activate security features.
See "Setting up and Managing SSP" to get started with deploying the Security Services Platform.
Security Services Platform Known Issues
Issue 3485307: Enabling Security intelligence on ESX hosts with Smart NICs can trigger "TN Flow Exp
Disconnected" alarm on DPUs.
Security intelligence is not supported by SmartNICs. There is no connection from DPUs to any of the brokers on Security
Services Platform or NSX Application Platform.
When Security intelligence is enabled, intelligence-specific configurations are pushed to SmartNICs. As there is no
connectivity from DPUs to Security intelligence, a flow export failure alarm is triggered. This issue is only applicable to
ESX hosts with SmartNICs.
Workaround: Resolve the alarm on NSX Manager UI.
Issue 3485270: The SSP Web Proxy certificate can be deleted via the UI even when it is configured in the system
web proxy page.
This does not affect system functioning. However, if the proxy configuration needs updating, the certificate needs to be re-
imported.
Workaround: Re-import the certificate if the proxy configuration needs updating.
Issue 3483539: SSP workload cluster VM recovery from a crash might result in fluent-bit and envoy pods getting
scheduled on control plane nodes, which is not supported.
CPU/memory usage on control plane node increases.
Workaround: Use the kubectl delete command to delete those pods in the control plane node.
Issue 3476378: Security Application installation resource capacity pre-check might fail after scale out.
You might not be able to reinstall/install verticals after scale out existing service in the current settings unless adding more
worker nodes or uninstalling existing verticals.
Workaround: Add more worker nodes.
Issue 3469740: Login to the Security Services Platform might fail with "incorrect credentials error" even when the
credentials entered are correct.
When logging into SSP, if any of these three services are down (authelia, authserver or postgres) and login is attempted,
you see the following error even if the credentials are correct: "Your login attempt was not successful. The username/
password combination is incorrect or the account specified has been locked."
Workaround: None.
Issue 3497195: Security Services Platform Installer restore on a fresh appliance fails intermittently on first
attempt.
VMware by Broadcom  11
